_notes.purpose: PTS Season Scoreboard data for TheDuchessFlame.com. Auto-generated from PTS ENTM exports by build_pts_season_scoreboard.py. Used by df-bnb-seasons.js (Scoreboards module).
_notes.pts_notice: This is PTS datamined data. No page assignments (layout 'pending', page '') until Bethesda releases the board. Ticket costs are set to 0 (unknown). Items may be added, removed, or rearranged before the season goes live. When the season is curated in season_rewards.tsv, build_season_rewards.py output supersedes this file.
